physics_reconfirmation.claim: panel (B) shading only past the crossover
physics_reconfirmation.evidence: Analytic crossover for N_b=50: the gap exponent (N_a-N_b)-(sqrt(N_a)-sqrt(N_b))^2 simplifies to 2*sqrt(N_b)*(sqrt(N_a)-sqrt(N_b)), which equals log 4 at N_a = 51.395903 (figure annotates 51.40). The panel-B fill trace (trace 4, fill='toself', on x2/y2) spans x in [51.4028, 75.0000]; min x >= crossover is True. No shading left of the crossover.

Le Cam floor (1/4)exp(-(sqrt(60)-sqrt(50))^2) = 1.585345e-01; folklore exp(-(60-50)) = 4.539993e-05; ratio = 3492.0 > 1000, matching the legend's 'certified ratio > 1000 at (N_b,N_a) = (50,60)'. Panel (C) gap exponent at the same point = 9.544512, matching the plotted annotation 9.5445. The companion panel-(A) witness also checks: exp(-(10-5))/exp(-10) = 148.4132 vs 'certified 148x'.

physics_reconfirmation.claim: ENBW*T = 1/2 saturated by the boxcar, ramp 2/3
physics_reconfirmation.verdict: CONFIRMED - both exact to the last bit
physics_reconfirmation.evidence: Boxcar trace is constant at 0.5 with error 0.00e+00 from 1/2; ramp trace is constant at 0.6666666666666666 with error 0.00e+00 from 2/3. Independently re-derived: for one-sided ENBW, ENBW*T = T*int h^2 / (2*(int h)^2); h=1 on [0,T] gives 1/2, h=t on [0,T] gives (T^3/3)/(2*(T^2/2)^2)*T = 2/3. Cauchy-Schwarz gives (int h)^2 <= T*int h^2, so 1/2 is a genuine least element attained only by the constant window - consistent with the 'floor 1/2 - IsLeast, sharp' annotation and with the ramp sitting strictly above as the 'one admissible point above'.

The fig-3 right-panel witness marker sits at exactly (x=3.00, y=2.000) and is labelled 'L = 3 -> 2'. The continuous right-panel trace satisfies max|y - |1-L|| = 0.000e+00 over its 600 samples, so the curve IS |1-L| pointwise, with its vertex at L=1. The round-3 error (reporting 4 at L=3) is gone.

physics_reconfirmation.claim: |1 - L| equals 4 at both L = 5 and L = -3

summary: Round 6 confirmation pass: GO for Stage 13. Zero FAIL, zero MAJOR, zero MINOR, zero publication-blocking findings. All four round-5 remediation items verified landed by independent execution and measurement, with no recurrence: the figure harness now runs end to end (137 specs, 0 errors, 0 issues touching D11/D12, deterministic at 44 issues across two trials); fig 3's expected_axes key is 'yaxis2' and a mutation test proves the fix is load-bearing rather than incidentally passing; fig 2's x-axis-title-to-legend clearance went 0.12 pt -> 5.00 pt, now matching its own legend row pitch; and D12's overfull-box count is 0. Both hardening items check out, with the 508 pt correction independently corroborated by the PDF's own x-ppi (508.2 pt placed) and reproducing the gate's 8.79/8.66/8.66 pt readings exactly. The new binding gate passes 7/7 with no drift. All five requested physics re-confirmations verify exactly from the live figure objects, including the |1-L| = 2 at L = 3 correction and the equal-4 stability-blind pair at L = 5 and L = -3. Artefact integrity is the strongest of any round so far: the three embedded PDF XObjects are pixel-identical to the shipped PNGs (maxdiff 0), which are in turn byte-identical to a fresh render from current source. The one caveat worth recording is procedural, not substantive - HEAD advanced one commit mid-review (98660389, scripts/review_runner.py only), disjoint from every judged artefact. Remaining residue is five INFO items, two of them the previously accepted MINORs; none blocks submission.
recommendations: PROCEED to Stage 13. Record the five INFO items as documented residue; do not iterate figures further.
Opportunistic, no round required: fix the stale '510 pt' prose at src/core/visualizations.py L14738-14741 next time the file is edited (D12-R6-XF-03).
Opportunistic: if fig 2 is ever revisited, a 2-column legend would use the reserved bottom margin better (D12-R6-F2-01).

For future waves: note that FigureSpec.physics_checks is manifest metadata and is never executed - the harness certifies structure, not physics, so an LLM or human physics pass remains required at Stage 9.

Carry the mutation-test step into future Stage-9 figure rounds. It is what distinguishes 'checked and passed' from 'not checked', and it caught nothing this round only because the wiring was genuinely fixed.
